market_view: European indices sit near records but tech sentiment is shaken by the Nvidia CEO exit (VIX +6.92%, IFX premarket -1.46%), while a firm dollar and Fed hike bets weigh on gold and copper and oil heads for a second weekly loss. No theme other than the held Infineon position has a primary-source, name-specific catalyst whose expected move clears twice its entry cost today.
would_change_my_mind: Infineon walking back its FY2027 growth guidance or a primary source naming IFX.DE in the BofA downgrade would make me close; a priced GSK settlement with material financial terms or agreed BP-Petrobras deal terms could justify a new long.
